scope: Bounded primary-source review, not an exhaustive uniqueness search. Downloaded source PDFs stay outside Git.

sources.name: carreira-2007
sources.read: PDF pages 1-4; equation 7 and EM construction/monotonicity.
sources.claim: Gaussian mean-shift identity, sigma squared=tau/2; the reflected composition is different.

sources.name: ryu-2019
sources.read: Publisher abstract and PDF pages 3-4; PNP-DRS/ADMM definitions and convergence assumptions.
sources.claim: Established denoiser splitting. Their operator ordering and strong-convexity assumptions are not transferred to our circle model.

sources.name: geppert-plonka
sources.read: PDF pages 1-3 and references on page 16.
sources.claim: Non-idempotent shrinkage used with RAAR; cited Loock/Plonka 2014 and Loock 2016 bodies unread.

sources.name: gribonval-characterization-2020
sources.read: Abstract, Corollary 1 and adjacent characterization statements on PDF pages 3-4.
sources.claim: Known convex-potential characterization; our explicit conjugate calculation is an application.

sources.name: gribonval-bayes-2021
sources.read: Abstract, Section 1.3 and Proposition 3 on PDF page 8.
sources.claim: Known Gaussian posterior-mean proximal representation; general proofs not audited.

sources.name: ramsauer-2021
sources.read: PDF pages 2-3 and 15-16, equation 3 and stated energy convergence scope.
sources.claim: Known unbiased softmax update. Our exact biased formula reduces to it only when site norms are exactly equal. Full reflected map is different.

sources.name: lee-2021
sources.read: Primary PDF page 3 text via web and author repository README. Local PDF download denied (403); no figure audit.
sources.claim: RAAR using denoised measurement constraints; this is not an asserted identity with our state-dependent finite-prior mean.
